rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with complete DigitalOcean cloud infrastructure management through 37 specialized tools across 6 service categories, built using Go with the official DigitalOcean godo SDK and OAuth2 authentication. The implementation offers full CRUD operations for droplets, volumes, snapshots, images, floating IPs, and load balancers, plus Kubernetes cluster management and container registry access, all organized into modular handlers with structured argument validation and comprehensive error handling. Built with stdio transport protocol integration and JSON schema validation for all tool parameters, it serves DevOps teams needing conversational cloud infrastructure management, developers wanting to automate DigitalOcean operations through AI assistants, and system administrators requiring programmatic access to the full spectrum of DigitalOcean services without direct API interaction.
